collection.title: BMW 5 Series Saloon 1995 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 5 Series Saloon 1995 to 2003 requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 26" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Latch arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
